stagflation.title: 1970s stagflation
stagflation.note: Costs compound at 9-11% while a balanced portfolio loses money in real terms.

ca_crash.title: California housing bust
ca_crash.note: Six consecutive years without a price gain; the county index took about a decade to recover.

gfc.title: Financial crisis
gfc.note: A one-year portfolio loss near 37% while the house also fell.

rate_shock.title: Rate shock
rate_shock.note: Bonds and shares fall together as inflation rises to 8%.

disaster.title: Uninsured earthquake
disaster.note: One $600,000 loss in year 11 with double insurance afterwards.

bootstrap.source: annual California CPI change (BOE LTA 2026/002) and Santa Clara County house-price change (FHFA via FRED), 1976-2025, resampled in consecutive five-year blocks; portfolio is a constant 5.0% nominal return less 0.5% fee, so its real return moves with the sampled inflation
